Author: brady.woods
Name: Sticker Chat
Punchline: Turns auto-translate phrases into stickers over players' heads.
Description:
When someone sends a chat message made up only of auto-translate phrases, replaces their native chat bubble with a sticker image. Mapping is 1:1 and user configurable. Receive-only: this plugin never sends chat and never reads your chat log.

Stickers live in packs, stamped with the character that authored them. Share one as a zip, an https link, or automatically with your Snowcloak pairs. Pack sync is off by default, only ever sends a link rather than images, and will not install a pack unless it belongs to the character sharing it.

Players without the plugin just see an ordinary auto-translate phrase.

Alpha: bubble replacement works and is confirmed in-game, but expect rough edges. Use /stickerchat to configure and /stickerchat debug to inspect bubble nodes.
